Our role

The right technology. The right integration.

Depending on project and partner arrangements, our work may include:

  • Technology identification and solution selection
  • Coordination with international manufacturers and providers
  • Systems integration and implementation support
  • Technical training and knowledge exchange, where arranged
  • Maintenance coordination and lifecycle support, where arranged

S3 does not manufacture the technologies represented by international providers. Product specifications, warranties and provider-specific services remain with the relevant company and are governed by its agreements.
